## About

Yum News publishes practical, step-by-step guides for Android, Gemini AI, Firebase, Claude, Google Home, and developer tooling. Coverage focuses on useful product workflows — from consumer Android features to SDK-level APIs and AI integrations. Articles are written for developers, makers, and technically curious readers.

## Categories

- **AI Tools & Tutorials** — Claude, Gemini, Gemma, ML Kit, Firebase AI Logic, Gemini Nano Banana image models, Google AI Studio, Firefox Smart Window, Mistral, Google Home MCP, Notion Agent Skills, Gemini Daily Brief, Speech Recognition, Gemini in Sheets, Gemini Gems, Gemini app for Windows, Android Computer Control
- **Android Apps & Updates** — Android 17, Pixel drops, new OS features, ADB, debugging
- **Technology How-To Guides** — Step-by-step walkthroughs for real-world tasks
